# Vendored libraries

Third-party code served from this repo (no CDN). Update by replacing the file and this note.

- **bwip-js 4.11.4** (MIT) — `bwip-js-4.11.4.min.js`, license in `bwip-js-LICENSE.txt`.
  Unmodified browser build from the npm package `bwip-js@4.11.4` (`dist/bwip-js-min.js`).
  Used by `codes.html` for QR codes and EAN-13 (ISBN) barcodes with the 5-digit add-on.
